lines.trans: The proposal for the new season is nearly ready, yet one huge problem remains.
The issue is that in the boss's mind, he probably wants a complete format overhaul.
He is fiercely independent and likes charting a blue-ocean course.
What he hates most is the kind of copycat competition happening right now.
He has mulled over a revamp for two seasons now, and this year he will surely do it.
Yet if the boss leaves hospital and scraps everything to start over, time will be way too tight.
And he would work through the night nonstop.
I can work overtime too.
The main thing is that a major revamp always faces heavy skepticism.
Without proper groundwork and communication beforehand, it will get shot down at the meeting.
Then let us tell Mr Chun Yuqiao the date of this pitch meeting in advance.
Believe me, he would pull out his IV tube and rush straight here from hospital—we must not tell him!
